newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Cardio started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Cardio started.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Thermo Cardiosystems Inc as hold.
-- said Thermo Cardio is "likely" to report negative earnings comparisons for the June and September quarters.
-- said improved profit prospects for 1998 are contingent upon the company receiving some approvals from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
-- said believes stock is best suited for "patient investors with an interest in emerging growth medical tech markets and with the ability to withstand a considerable degree of the volatility."
